environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with standard IAM role. Service has both HSM (nCipher nShield Connect XC) and software PKCS12 keystore mounted at /opt/keys/signing.p12. Network policy allows egress to HSM on port 9004. No input validation middleware. The /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/config endpoint is exposed to internal services without authentication.

config.hsm: nCipher nShield Connect XC, PKCS#11 provider registered
